sloka: सर्पाः पंचानना भूत्वा भक्षयन्ति स्म राक्षसान् ।येन येन च गच्छन्ति राक्षसा भय कर्शिताः ॥३-३१-१९॥
transliteration: sarpāḥ paṁcānanā bhūtvā bhakṣayanti sma rākṣasān ।yena yena ca gacchanti rākṣasā bhaya karśitāḥ ॥3-31-19॥

translations.english: Wherever the demons went they, gripped by fear, only saw Rama in front. O sinless sire In this manner your Janasthana was destroyed by him.
